build_FourierFeaturesMLP: build a Haiku MLP module that applies Fourier features encoding to input values with configurable frequencies
create_NoiseEncoderConfig: create a NoiseEncoderConfig dataclass to configure noise level encoding with Fourier features and MLP layer sizes
create_DenoiserArchitectureConfig: create a DenoiserArchitectureConfig dataclass to define the GenCast denoiser architecture with sparse transformer and mesh settings
run_Denoiser_call: run the Denoiser class to process inputs with noisy targets and noise levels through the GenCast predictor
run_DenoiserArchitecture_call: run the _DenoiserArchitecture predictor to transform grid inputs through grid2mesh, mesh, and mesh2grid GNN stages
